name: assistant-cloud
description: Local inert stub. @assistant-ui/core statically imports this optional peer dep from its react/index.js barrel even though it is marked optional in peerDependenciesMeta and unused by this prototype (no cloud thread-list/history features are exercised). Without SOME resolvable module here, `npm install` having completed cleanly still leaves the package unimportable at runtime (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND) — this stub is a targeted, additive fix scoped to unblocking that single static import, not a real implementation. Not added via npm install/package.json to avoid depending on a fake registry package. Mirrors the identical stub used in the sibling proto-lia493-assistant-ui-ink worktree's node_modules/assistant-cloud (same root cause, same fix).
